title: Thai vowels (สระ อา, อำ) not rendering correctly in input/output
body: ## Description Thai combining vowels like สระ อา (า - sara aa) and สระ อำ (ำ - sara am) are not rendering correctly in Claude Code CLI. This affects both: 1. **Input**: Users cannot type these characters 2. **Output**: Even Claude's responses have these characters stripped/missing ## Evidence Screenshot showing the issue - notice how Thai vowels are missing from Claude's own output: - "สระ อ ()" instead of "สระ อา (า)" - "ต้องกร" instead of "ต้องการ" ## Environment - **OS**: macOS (Darwin 25.2.0) - **Thai Keyboard Layout**: Kedmanee - **Affected characters**: า (sara aa), ำ (sara am), possibly other Thai combining characters ## Expected Behavior Thai text should render correctly with all vowels and tone marks intact, both in user input and Claude's output. ## Actual Behavior Thai combining characters (particularly sara aa and sara am) are being stripped or not displayed in the terminal output. ## Notes This appears to be a Unicode handling issue specific to Thai combining characters in the CLI's terminal rendering.
author: MateTosapon
